positions.title: Purchasing Assistant
positions.description:
• Handle receiving and logistics of products from our various vendors. 
• Perform courier services involving inter-department and outgoing U.S. mail/parcels.
• Correspond with department managers answering any inquiries pertaining to shipments/supplies.
• Ensure all paperwork is accurate and prompt for processing to our billing department.

positions.title: Production Manager
positions.description:
• In charge of managing employees in warehouse.
• Ensured expedient loading and receiving of products from shipment containers.
• Instructed employees with their daily workload via purchase orders based on delivery deadlines.
• In charge of monthly inventory and storage of incoming product.
• In charge of running and maintaining heavy equipment used to create our product for shipping to customers.
